images.name: Shady
images.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: the Shady library hero banner for the existing treeform.org project grid.
Primary request: revise the existing Shady banner so its background looks like a Cornell box and its central logo looks like a shaded sphere.
Input images: Image 1 is the current Shady banner, the edit target; use it to preserve the wide 2:1 composition, full-bleed background, central emblem scale and thumbnail readability. Image 2 is a reference for the Cornell box environment only. Image 3 is a reference for the round shaded sphere logo's tonal shading and glossy highlight only.
Replace the mountain scenery with a clean, beautifully rendered Cornell box interior: matte red left wall, matte green right wall, pale neutral back wall and floor, a rectangular ceiling area light, soft contact shadows and subtle realistic red and green bounced light. Show the room head-on with clear perspective, filling the complete wide canvas. Keep the lighting restrained enough for a clear logo.
Replace the triangular logo with ONE centered circular grayscale shaded sphere emblem, about 50 to 55 percent of the canvas height. It should read as a simple sphere logo at small card size: crisp circular silhouette, bright white and silver upper-left highlight, smooth gray shading into a charcoal lower-right edge, and a restrained broad glossy highlight, inspired by image 3. Keep the sphere predominantly neutral grayscale so it stands out from the red and green setting. Center it vertically and horizontally with generous room around it, like the original library mark. A sphere emblem over the rendered environment, not a collection of objects. Remove the original triangle completely.
Composition invariants: one complete finished banner, exact 2:1 landscape aspect ratio, ideally 1774 by 887 pixels. Full-bleed artwork, no margins or letterboxing, emblem entirely inside the central 50 percent of the width and 70 percent of the height. No words, captions, lettering, watermarks, stock image credit, border, collage, or interface. Do not reproduce any text from the references.

references.description: Previous Shady mountain and triangular emblem banner at commit 13a25fe.
User-supplied Cornell box photograph with a red left wall, green right wall, neutral interior, overhead light and three spheres.
User-supplied grayscale glossy shaded sphere, used for spherical shape and tonal shading.

No wording, lettering, captions, labels, watermark, frames, border, black bars, interface mockup, collage, or multiple panels. Avoid generic glowing neon tech art and avoid turning the emblem into a physical 3D object. One complete banner only.

Project concept: Pretty-printing library. Background: soft pearlescent pink and rose translucent folded glass with subtle prismatic highlights and tactile depth, elegant rather than neon. Emblem: three neatly aligned white horizontal lines of descending length with a small four-point sparkle at upper right, balanced graphic showing polished output.
